name: voice-bot
description: Outbound telephone calls through a configurable voice API. VoiceCall dials a real phone number and hands the conversation to a voice agent briefed by the prompt sent with the call.

configSchema.label: Call endpoint
configSchema.hint: Full URL each call request is sent to. Without it and the token below, no call tool is offered to the agent at all.

configSchema.label: API token
configSchema.hint: Sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. It is never written to a log line and never returned to the agent, not even in an error.

configSchema.label: Maximum calls per hour
configSchema.hint: Calls started in any 60-minute window. This is the only brake on the feature: it exists to stop a repeating agent from dialling somebody over and over, and it survives a restart.

configSchema.label: Longest call
configSchema.hint: How long a single call may run before the connection is given up on. The service holds the request open for the whole conversation, so this is a call length, not a connection timeout: set too low, a call that went perfectly well is reported as having an unknown outcome. A measured short call took 42 seconds.

configSchema.label: Default opening sentence
configSchema.hint: Spoken first whenever a call does not carry its own opening sentence. Leave empty to let the voice service open the call by itself.
